Findings
Recommendation 1 — The pre-metric prediction-hash receipt has two consumers and no producer
Recommendation 2 — The chokepoint's one-door rule is contradicted by three live test modules, with no carve-out anywhere
Recommendation 3 — `models-and-baselines`' leakage guard targets `FeatureBundle` fields ADR-11 retired
Recommendation 4 — BLK-09 is unmet and de-labelled in its sole owning unit; the range-equality check has no lower bound
Recommendation 5 — `test_clean_run.py` is specified to execute scripts Phase 1 may not run
Recommendation 6 — The locked-test scored set was reduced from 31 days to 30 with no D-number, no change record, and no revised split manifest
Recommendation 7 — BLK-08's joint contract is half-authored, and its resolver re-exposes the `Transform.apply` surface ADR-11 removed
Recommendation 8 — `PartitionError` is undeclared and used inconsistently; nineteen exceptions sit outside `foundation` R-01's "all fourteen"
Recommendation 9 — TA-23 is G-09's own acceptance row, claimed as supporting with neither its evidence artifact designed nor its discharging requirement named
Recommendation 10 — `locked_test_accessed` and `prediction_hash` are designed on the access record but not on the experiment registry the authority names
Recommendation 11 — The unit performing the required pre-G-05 December audit binds no `purpose` literal, while three siblings depend on the one it never names
Recommendation 12 — Vision §8.3's exploratory label has a reader in one unit and a writer in none
Recommendation 13 — The ≤3 h carry-forward bound has no stated meaning for the one daily-cadence driver
Recommendation 14 — The `reanalysed-value check` is named three times and defined nowhere, and is not executable on any of the four driver series
Recommendation 15 — The December regime-count audit window is unbounded while the test scores 30 days
Recommendation 16 — The 30-day December scope is disclosed on no claim surface, and the primary results table carries no mask ID, row counts or exclusions
Recommendation 17 — TC-12's interpretive half reaches no checklist row in the unit that produces the artifact inviting the prohibited inference
Recommendation 18 — NFR-TDEF-01's grid-cell-versus-IPP mismatch is routed only through the IRI/GIM comparison path, so a Phase 1 release discloses it nowhere
Recommendation 19 — Vision §2.4's tier-3 learned-model comparison exists in no declared comparison set and is unimplementable as designed
Recommendation 20 — RMSE and the derived percentage reduction appear nowhere, leaving the practical-relevance layer with only its demotion limb
Recommendation 21 — The binding honesty rule's check runs against a conclusion surface no unit declares, owns or locates
Recommendation 22 — Twenty-three percent of `**Acceptance.**` statements carry no §16/§19 row, and the §15.2 rows that would close them arrive at this gate unruled
Recommendation 23 — The bootstrap widening guard is promoted to a runtime raise and strengthened to fire on equality, on an unmeasured premise
Recommendation 24 — TE §15.3's mandatory reduced-replicate fixture bootstrap is designed nowhere, and two rules make it unrepresentable
Recommendation 25 — `DEC.train_end` is unspecified, so the necessity of the one enumerated weakening of the identity rule cannot be verified
Recommendation 26 — The block-resampling scheme is routed to the gate by its own rule but omitted from that unit's gate-items list
Recommendation 27 — The mandated test set is understated by four modules at five sites, two of which claim to be derived
Recommendation 28 — `provenance_class` reaches no unit but the one that invented it, leaving `write_release` a choice §18.3 forbids
Recommendation 29 — The unit hosting G-P1A carries no DATA-07 provenance caveat at all
Recommendation 30 — One unit's recorded decision contradicts its own implementing rule on the §15.2 count it escalated
Recommendation 31 — Five December accesses were logged retrospectively and one possible unauthorized access is expressly unresolved
Recommendation 32 — `models-and-baselines` states a superseded amendment total as a live, unqualified assumption
Recommendation 33 — `team.md` carries three stale facts, and the rule bundle propagated one of them into this review's own dispatch
Recommendation 34 — `foundation` R-05 claims WS-17 while carving the bootstrap seed out of its own scope
Recommendation 35 — `EstimandResult` carries none of the three mandated stamps, though it is the comparison
Recommendation 36 — D-14's operative second clause is enumerated nowhere, on the fixture whose numbers are allowed to be evidence
Recommendation 37 — The cross-cutting phase-boundary guard enforces five forbidden field classes where D-17 names more
Recommendation 38 — The interpolation prohibition rests on a grep with no named token set and no conservation invariant
Recommendation 39 — §13.4's atomic-or-append-safe registry requirement is checked off against two rules that do not carry it
Recommendation 40 — TE §9.3's storage budget is used as a RAM/CPU envelope; the conflation originates upstream
Recommendation 41 — The GIM overlap-flag disclosure is keyed to the audit having run rather than to a GIM comparison existing
Recommendation 42 — `dataset_version`'s never-reuse obligation is open and its encoding unspecified, leaving `write_release` unimplementable
Recommendation 43 — The VAL-05 Phase-2 disclosure is present but is the only one of three adjacent mandated disclosures with no named falsifier
Recommendation 44 — Two December-bearing artifacts sit outside the reach of the guards designed to cover them
Recommendation 45 — The affirmed gate-test execution mechanism does not exist, and 28 commits have landed without it
Recommendation 46 — Two `external-products` artifacts cite D-25 operatively while omitting it from their source register
Recommendation 47 — No session wall-clock ceiling exists in any authority, and the in-session gate stacks fixtures inside the governed session
Recommendation 48 — The new `src/evaluation` → `src/features` edge does not weaken benchmark isolation (refutation attempted and failed)
Recommendation 49 — `foundation`'s NFR-SEC-01 status sentence is dated and now partly superseded
